Available for international direct client engagements, remote consulting, and technical leadership contracts.

## Verifiable Open Source & Package Footprint

Hassaan is a recognized contributor in the PHP and Laravel ecosystem:

- **`bschmitt/laravel-amqp` (Collaborator · 2.5M+ Downloads):**
  - Upstream collaborator with multiple merged PRs maintaining enterprise AMQP RabbitMQ messaging support across modern PHP 8 and Laravel releases.
  - Repository: https://github.com/bschmitt/laravel-amqp
  - Modernized Docs: https://zfhassaan.github.io/laravel-amqp

- **`zfhassaan/jazzcash` (Author & Maintainer):**
  - The leading open-source Laravel integration package for JazzCash (Pakistan's largest mobile financial service).
  - Features HMAC cryptographic signing, hosted checkout builders, and sandbox toggles.
  - Packagist: https://packagist.org/packages/zfhassaan/jazzcash
  - Repository: https://github.com/zfhassaan/jazzcash

- **`zfhassaan/payfast` (Author & Maintainer):**
  - Complete merchant gateway SDK for PayFast supporting direct & hosted checkouts, signed Instant Payment Notifications (IPN), and idempotency protections.
  - Packagist: https://packagist.org/packages/zfhassaan/payfast
  - Documentation: https://zfhassaan.github.io/payfast/

- **`zfhassaan/laravel-wallet` (Author & Maintainer):**
  - Production-grade immutable double-entry ledger e-wallet package.
  - Eliminates balance race conditions via pessimistic row locks (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`), cryptographic hash validation, and tamper auto-freeze.
  - Documentation: https://zfhassaan.github.io/laravel-wallet/

- **`zfhassaan/dbx` (Author & Maintainer):**
  - Cross-platform Go CLI utility for streaming, compressed, offsite database backups across MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MongoDB to AWS S3, Google Cloud, and Azure Blob storage.
  - Repository: https://github.com/zfhassaan/dbx

## Proven Commercial Client Work

Hassaan has delivered production systems for government entities, enterprise retail, and high-volume digital platforms:

1. **UAE SWAT Challenge (Dubai Police Event Platform):**
   - High-traffic official competition platform handling international law enforcement team rosters, tournament draws, live leaderboards, and spectator ticketing workflows.
   - URL: https://www.uaeswatchallenge.com/en

2. **Haier Mall (Enterprise Retail & Appliance E-Commerce):**
   - Flagship direct-to-consumer digital marketplace for Haier Pakistan with high-concurrency flash sale traffic, multi-gateway checkout, and automated inventory sync.
   - URL: https://www.haiermall.pk

3. **Online Auction (Real-Time UAE Bidding Infrastructure):**
   - Low-latency real-time bidding system for vehicle and commercial asset auctions. Implemented pessimistic concurrency locks and sub-100ms WebSocket bid broadcast.
   - URL: https://onlineauction.ae

4. **Zoom Packaging (Custom Manufacturing B2B SaaS):**
   - Dynamic volumetric box dimension calculator, wholesale tiered pricing engine, and automated dieline artwork intake portal based in Austin, Texas.
   - URL: https://zoompackaging.com/
